restoration_note: Teaching describes the soul in trial finding no resting-gate among the powers of heaven and earth (her defilers) but only in the sun and moon — the two ships of light, Divine Truth in its illuminating manifestation and receptive reflection — through which she ascends to the country of her kindred; and how, by correspondence, the Land of Light becomes the final resting-receiver of those luminaries themselves. Most gaps are short editorial completions of formulae repeated within the chapter (ⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲥⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ, ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̄ⲙ̄ⲡⲧⲏⲩⲉ, ϣⲁⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ) and are restored with high confidence. The lacuna {4} (the verb of the defilers' continuing action) admits the standard Manichaean ⲗⲱⲭⲍ̄ "defile" by paradigm. The lacuna {6} (the 3-char particle opening the resumptive sentence after ⲛⲉ "they are") is not securely constrained and is left unrestored.

restorations.basis: Editor's completion of the Greek loanword ⲯⲩⲭⲏ at page edge; standard formula ⲧⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'the living soul' (lexicon: soul ⲯⲩⲭⲏ).
Completes ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ (visible ⲛⲍ̄), forming the established phrase ⲧⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'the living soul' that governs the whole teaching (cf. l.62 ⲛ̄ⲧⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄). Lexicon: living = ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄.
Completes ⲁⲃⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'to go upward' — the standard ascent-idiom of the soul rising to the house of her kindred (lexicon: ascend = ⲃⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈).
Completes ⲥⲥⲁⲩⲛⲉ ⲛ̄ⲥⲣ̄ⲁⲓⲥⲑⲁⲛⲉ 'she knows and-she-perceives' across the line break (ⲥⲥⲁⲩ at l.51 end, the gap supplies ⲉ closing ⲥⲁⲩⲛⲉ plus the conjunctive ⲛ̄ before ⲥⲣ̄ⲁⲓⲥⲑⲁⲛⲉ).

The relative ⲉⲧ governs the verb of the ⲣⲉϩⲗⲱⲭⲍ̄ 'defilers' continuing action; the cognate verb ⲗⲱⲭⲍ̄ 'to defile' fits the est. ~3-glyph slot and matches the chapter's correspondential point that the powers of heaven and earth are the soul's mingling-defilers in every place.
Completes ⲉⲙⲏⲧⲓ 'except' — the exceptive particle introducing the sun and moon as the sole open gate (parallels ⲉⲓⲙⲏⲧⲓ at l.59 in identical exceptive function).

3-char slot opens a new clause after ⲛⲉ 'they are'. Several short particles/demonstratives (ⲛⲁⲓ, ⲱⲛ̄, ⲛⲇⲉ) would fit syntactically and contextually, but no formula in the chapter or wider corpus uniquely constrains the choice; honest non-restoration preferred.
Completes ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲟ̄ⲓⲛⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'in the going-forth' — the spatial-modal phrase governing the ascent through the gate (ⲣⲟ ⲉϥⲟⲩⲏⲛ) of the two luminaries.
Completes ⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲥⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'the house of her men' — the celestial homeland of the soul's kindred; identical formula at l.51 (ⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲥⲣⲱⲙⲉ) and l.63-64.
Completes ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'the Land of Light' (visible ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ on next line); the celestial homeland that is theirs forever (lexicon: Land of Light = ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ).
Completes ⲁⲧⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲥⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'unto the house of her men' across the line break (ⲛⲉⲥⲣⲱⲙⲉ visible on next line); identical formula at l.51 and l.57.
Completes ⲙ̄ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̄ⲙ̄ⲡⲧⲏⲩⲉ 'the luminaries of the heavens' across the line break (ⲡⲧⲏⲩⲉ visible on next line); identical phrase at l.55 and l.58-59.
Completes ϣⲁⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ 'forever' (visible ⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ on next line) — the standard doxological terminus closing the eschatological assurance that the luminaries reign in the Land of Light forever.
